title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 5 — WORLD 3: B1 COMMUNICATION CORE
description: Grade 5 World 3 moves into practical B1 communication through richer grammar, connected texts, natural listening, sustained conversation, opinion language, storytelling and real-world problem solving.

missions.title: B1 Vocabulary Engine
missions.focus: collocations, phrasal verbs, word families, useful chunks and context-based meaning

missions.title: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
missions.focus: experiences, finished past events, time expressions and choosing the correct tense in conversation

missions.title: Narrative Tense Control
missions.focus: past simple, past continuous and past perfect for clear chronological storytelling

missions.title: Future Plans, Intentions & Predictions
missions.focus: will, going to and present continuous with evidence, arrangements and personal plans

missions.title: Second Conditional Starter
missions.focus: imaginary situations, wishes, hypothetical choices and giving reasons

missions.title: Relative Clauses
missions.focus: who, which, that and where for adding useful information to descriptions

missions.title: Passive Voice Basics
missions.focus: understanding and producing simple passive sentences in everyday factual English

missions.title: Communication & Relationships
missions.focus: emotions, personality, conflict, cooperation, invitations, apologies and social responses

missions.title: Environment & Our World
missions.focus: nature, pollution, recycling, climate, responsible choices and explaining simple cause and effect

missions.title: B1 Conversation Lab — Eight Minutes
missions.focus: sustained conversation with follow-up questions, comparisons, explanations, experiences and opinions

missions.title: Reading Explorer — The Choice
missions.focus: 800–950 word B1 text with gist, detail, inference, reference words, attitude and context vocabulary

missions.title: Listening Mission — Natural Conversations
missions.focus: 7–9 minute multi-speaker audio with reduced pauses, connected speech, purpose and attitude

missions.title: Writing Mission — For & Against
missions.focus: 220–260 word balanced response using reasons, examples, connectors and a clear conclusion

missions.title: Storytelling Lab — A Turning Point
missions.focus: telling a longer story with setting, conflict, sequence, dialogue, reaction and resolution

missions.title: Real-Life English — Booking & Changing Plans
missions.focus: making reservations, changing arrangements, confirming information and solving booking problems

missions.title: Real-Life English — At Work & In the Community
missions.focus: basic workplace communication, responsibilities, requests, schedules and community services

missions.title: Opinion Lab — Explain Your Thinking
missions.focus: expressing opinions, giving evidence, softening disagreement and responding to another person's idea

missions.title: Problem-Solving Simulation
missions.focus: understand a situation, identify options, compare solutions, negotiate a choice and explain the result

missions.title: B1 Integrated Skills Marathon
missions.focus: full review of vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, reading, listening, speaking, writing and real-life English

missions.title: WORLD 3 MASTER QUEST — B1 COMMUNICATION CORE
missions.focus: multi-stage B1 assessment combining reading, listening, storytelling, opinion, problem solving, writing and sustained conversation

content_targets.core_vocabulary: 900+ active words, collocations, phrasal verbs and communication chunks
content_targets.mastery: Learner demonstrates emerging independent B1 communication by connecting ideas, explaining reasons, handling practical situations, telling developed stories and participating in longer conversations.
